meta.format: RGBA8888 (Pillow); an indexed copy made with pngquant sits beside it as <name>.q.png

packing.note: Untrimmed grid: one row per animation, 2 px gutter, frame = sourceSize, pivot at the anchor.

pivot.note: shadow centre; draw at the ground point under the gull: (e.x, e.y + 30 frame px of the gull sheet = +15 world units at the gull's scale)

body.note: same refBodyR as seagull_a (24.3 px) so the shadow scales exactly like the gull; 2 px per world unit at the design radius

meta.license: Original art generated for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower with Grok Bot GenerateImage; no third-party packs.

draw.at: ground point under the gull: (e.x, e.y + 30 frame px) = 15 world units below the body; scale with the gull; draw BEFORE (under) the gull and under other enemies
draw.note: opacity is already in the alpha; draw at globalAlpha 1. Optional: shrink to ~85% on the wings-up frames.

provenance.postProcess: _tools/shadows.py: key white, split, scale x0.2119 to 0.9 x median gull span, alpha x0.35

meta.note: no MANIFEST slot (optional extra); draw under the gull at globalAlpha 1 (0.35 is baked in)

quantizedCopy.metric: PSNR / max error on premultiplied RGBA (colour under alpha 0 ignored)
quantizedCopy.note: same layout as the RGBA original; use either (the RGBA original stays the master)
